requirement.statement: The runtime package SHALL remove the legacy Interpreter execution pipeline and expose RuntimeInterpreter as the active interpreter surface.

case.given: The package public index is imported
case.when: A consumer inspects exported interpreter APIs
case.then: The package SHALL NOT export Interpreter, XnlState, ExtensionRegistry, or XnlOpCode from the legacy execution pipeline

case.given: The legacy interpreter files have been removed
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter scripts and compatibility tests run
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL continue to provide the migrated legacy runtime capabilities
